content: The capable hawk hides its talons.
author: Japanese Proverbs
sourceWork: Nou aru taka wa tsume wo kakusu (能ある鷹は爪を隠す)
explanation: Those who possess genuine power, deep skill, and formidable intellect feel no urge to flaunt them on every street corner. Vanity advertises what it barely possesses; supreme mastery rests quietly in reserve until the precise moment action is required.
practicalInsight: Resist the urge to show off or announce your accomplishments in meetings or social feeds today. Let your results speak in silence.
reflectionPrompt: Why do you feel the urge to prove your intelligence or importance to others, and what would happen if you rested in quiet capability?
